app.tagline: No employer? Coinvoy gives you what an employer gives.
intro.label: Welcome to Coinvoy
intro.s1Body: Coinvoy is a payroll department for one person: you. Built for Grab, foodpanda and every gig rider in Malaysia.
intro.s2Title: RM900 one week. RM400 the next.
intro.s2Body: 1.64 million Malaysians earn from gig work, and most have no savings to fall back on. Good weeks get spent and slow weeks hurt. We built Coinvoy to change that.
intro.s3Body: Employees get five things riders don't. Coinvoy gives you all five.
intro.s4Body: Coinvoy only works with your own money, in your own bank or e-wallet.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.collect: Your Google account name and email, your weekly earnings figures, bills, costs, pots and the choices you make in the app.
privacy.why: To work out your own weekly salary, buffer, leave and statement. Nothing else.
privacy.screenshots: Never stored. A screenshot or PDF is sent once to be read, then dropped. Location data in a photo is removed first.
privacy.keep: Your data is kept while your account is active. Tanya messages are deleted after 90 days. Demo accounts are deleted after 24 hours.
privacy.rights: See, download or delete all your data any time in Profile. Fix any week in Records.
privacy.never: Sell your data, lend money, hold your money, or make a credit score.
privacy.aiTitle: AI and who sees your data
privacy.aiOff: AI features are off. No data is sent to an AI provider.

scam.entry: Paste an SMS, WhatsApp or link
scam.body: Got an odd message about your account, a prize, a parcel or a job? Paste it here. We show the warning signs and what to do.
scam.placeholder: Paste the message or link here…
scam.private: The message isn't stored. Don't tap links in it before checking.
scam.none: No common scam signs found. That isn't a guarantee: if unsure, contact the company through its own app or official number.
scam.flag.asks_code: Asks for a TAC, OTP, PIN or password. Banks, Grab and other companies never ask for these.
scam.flag.apk: Asks you to download an app or .apk file outside the Play Store / App Store. It can read your SMS and bank codes.
scam.flag.mule: Asks to rent, buy or borrow your bank account. That makes it a mule account: the owner can be charged.
scam.flag.authority: Claims to be police, LHDN, a court or Bank Negara and threatens arrest or investigation. Authorities don't do this by phone or WhatsApp.
scam.flag.pay_first: Asks you to pay first (tax, a fee, shipping) to receive a prize, loan or item.
scam.flag.account_blocked: Says your account or card is blocked or expiring, to make you panic.
scam.flag.urgent: Pushes you to act now or within a short time.
scam.flag.prize: Says you won a prize or draw you didn't enter.
scam.flag.job_offer: An easy job with high pay (likes, follows, online tasks).
scam.flag.short_link: Uses a short link (like bit.ly) that hides the real site.
scam.flag.lookalike_link: A link that copies a real company's name but isn't its official site.
scam.flag.ip_link: A link to a number address (IP), not a real company's site.
scam.neverShare: Don't share a TAC/OTP, don't tap the link, and don't transfer money. If unsure, open the company's own app.
scam.muleBody: Look up phone numbers or bank accounts reported for scams.
scam.nsrcBody: The National Scam Response Centre. The sooner you call, the better the chance the bank can stop the money.
scam.usedAi: Checked with AI help and our rules.

pocket.title: Set up your pay pocket
pocket.intro: Coinvoy never holds your money. It stays in your own bank; you just keep part of it in a separate pocket so slow weeks are already paid for.

pocket.step2.body: Each bank names it differently: Pocket, Tabung, Goals or Saving Space. Call it "Coinvoy buffer".
pocket.step3.title: No pockets? Open a second account
pocket.step3.body: A digital bank account is usually free and takes minutes. Any separate account works.
pocket.step4.title: Every payday, move what Coinvoy says
pocket.step4.body: Coinvoy tells you how much to move in (busy weeks) or take out (slow weeks). What's left in your main account is your salary.

privacy.intro: Coinvoy turns your gig earnings into a steady weekly salary. This page says, in plain words, what we keep, why, and what you can do about it.
privacy.g1: We never sell your data, lend you money or hold your money.
privacy.g2: Screenshots and PDFs are read once, then dropped. Never stored.
privacy.g3: Download or delete all your data any time, in Profile.
privacy.g4: AI reads your data only if you allow it, and you can switch it off.
privacy.source: Only from you: your Google sign-in, what you type, and the screenshots or PDFs you upload. We get nothing from your bank, the delivery apps or anyone else.
privacy.required: Only your Google sign-in, so your data belongs to your account alone. Everything else is up to you, but without your earnings Coinvoy can't work out a salary.
privacy.aiAllow: Only if you allow it. Switch it off any time in Profile → AI reading; everything still works by typing.
privacy.shareIndex: Rider Index: only if you switch it on, your hourly rate is added with no name or account attached, and shown only for groups of 20+ riders.
privacy.shareOfficer: Income statement: a loan officer sees it only through a link you make, and you can cancel the link any time.
privacy.contact: Email {email} about your data or this notice.
privacy.noContact: A contact email hasn't been set yet.
privacy.bilingual: This notice is in Bahasa Melayu and English; switch with the button at the top.
